_why: Step 5. A negative case: it passes by the agent NOT acting. Several off-topic messages in a row, where one 'morning' would not test anything. Nothing should be looked up and nothing logged.
persona: In a good mood, killing two minutes. Not here to check in about anything.
goal: Chat idly. Ask the app something about itself, make a passing remark about the weather or the coffee. If it tries to start a check-in, deflect and keep chatting. You do not want to talk about work today.
